title: Incivility and Rigidity: Evaluating the Risks of Fine-Tuning LLMs for Political Argumentation

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning GPT-3.5 Turbo on distinct political discourse datasets (high-incivility Twitter data vs. low-incivility Reddit data) and evaluating the generated arguments using the Perspective API for discourse quality (toxicity, respect, compassion) alongside an LLM-assisted annotation pipeline to measure rhetorical alignment and authority moves.
